idle.label: Idle
idle.tooltip: Idle: does not start while a normal or forced motion is playing, so that other motions can replace a looping idle motion.

normal.label: Normal
normal.tooltip: Normal: replaces idle and normal motions. Does not start while a forced motion is playing.

force.label: Force
force.tooltip: Force: always starts and replaces the playing motion.

motion.rejected: "{{name}}" did not start because its priority ({{priority}}) is lower than the playing motion.
